test_health_endpoint: test the health endpoint by calling /health with a bearer token and asserting model count is greater than zero
test_health_readiness: test the health readiness endpoint by calling /health/readiness and asserting litellm_version and status fields exist
test_health_liveliness: test the health liveliness endpoint by calling /health/liveliness and asserting a 200 status code
test_routes_endpoint: test the routes endpoint by calling /routes and asserting a 200 status code
generate_api_key: generate an api key by calling /key/generate with a list of models and bearer token authorization
